def load():
    import pathlib
    p = pathlib.Path('data/environment/input/boston-harbor-beaches.txt')
    lines = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    lines = [l.strip() for l in lines if l.strip()]
    import pandas as pd
    return pd.DataFrame({'beach': lines})
